methods.what: Change of variables to elementary symmetric functions y=x1+x2, z=x1x2 for a sum of two differentials
Chain rule relations between derivatives in (x1,x2) and (y,z)
Quartic equation F(t,y,z)=0 satisfied by t = ±s1 ± s2
Taylor expansion of s1^2+s2^2 about y/2 (even terms only)
Antisymmetric coefficients a with Σ x a = 0 expressed through a fully skew system b
Reduction of differential to inhomogeneous coordinates ξ for a homogeneous F
